title: The August 2026 Eclipse: A Shadow's Path From the Arctic to a Spanish Sunset
description: A total eclipse crosses Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain on 12 August — and Madrid and Barcelona miss it by a sliver.

title: The Lobito Corridor: Which Ocean Africa's Copper Flows To
description: A US- and EU-backed railway revives an Atlantic route for Central Africa's copper and cobalt — racing a China-backed line to the Indian Ocean.

title: The Red Sea Crisis: Trade Reroutes Around a War Zone
description: Houthi attacks near the Bab-el-Mandeb strait pushed global shipping onto a 10-day detour around Africa.
